limitations: Two calls per arm are descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals or acceptance evidence.
All sampled threads are included, with blocked wait signatures separated. Unknown off-CPU time, scheduler effects and sampling overhead remain unmeasured.
No hardware counters were captured: these counts cannot establish cache misses, memory bandwidth, dependency stalls or causality.
Inlined work and unsymbolized generic helpers remain in their enclosing bucket; old fusion includes update/norm and adjoint and cannot be split into those phases reliably.
sample coalesces PC offset lists, sometimes with ellipses; there are no individual PC weights. Fold offset groups are retained without inventing an instruction-level distribution.
Firm and third categorical Fold terms share the same specialization, so function samples cannot split their costs.
Existing build differences, ordinary desktop activity and bound Claude noise are retained. Native science/work checks are reused, not rerun.
Every profile retains its complete science/work summary and head/column/log hashes; numerical column arrays are not embedded.
Sample counts are neither milliseconds nor hardware-counter measurements. Blocked waiting and input parsing are separated.
The sampler coalesces displayed PC offsets and may omit some; no individual PC weights are available.
The two Fold terms share one sampled specialization; their individual costs cannot be inferred.
Historical source review and Astra text are retained with their earlier scope, not as endorsement of unseen profiles or a patch.
No new native call, build, profile or timing was performed while packaging. Captures have not been deleted.
